messages:
marta: Quick heads-up — PR 7365 (adaptive-batcher) looks like it introduced a tail latency bump on long-seq microbench. Can we hold merge until we confirm? :eyes:
marta: Local microbench (16k seq, 8-token prompt) — baseline vs PR (median / p95 / p99):
```
baseline:  ms/token 0.42  /  p95 190ms  /  p99 260ms
PR7365:    ms/token 0.44  /  p95 205ms  /  p99 290ms  (~10-12% p99 increase)
```
alex: Thanks for the report. Do we have the CI perf artifacts or canary data? Any variance across runs?
shreya: Is this with the new kernel selection enabled or just batching policy change?
marta: It's with the new batching horizon heuristic on (the change in PR). I ran 10 repeats locally; numbers are stable across runs (~8-12% p99 uplift). CI artifacts: bench-bot posted a run earlier.
bench-bot: perf run uploaded: https://ci.internal/runs/7365/perf-summary.txt — artifacts + raw logs.
alex: Opening the artifact now. If this is the batching horizon, it might be trading avg for tail. Can you paste the exact bench command you used?
tj: I can run an independent canary on dedicated pool if we want to validate at scale. Need the command and a tag for the image.
marta: Command I used: `./bench/microbench --model=gpt-j-16k --seq=16384 --batch=1 --warmup=50 --iters=500 --config=adaptive-horizon=true`
marta: Image tag: `sha-9f3b` (the one from PR build).
shreya: Also note PR modifies kernel selection for q4_0 path; that could change tail behavior for long keys.
alex: Okay — plan proposal: hold merge, run canary with tj (2 runs at load), and get a 2nd review from @shreya on kernel change. If canary shows similar uplift, we either revert or narrow the horizon tweak.
tj: I can start canary in ~30min. Tag me if you want me to include real traffic-ish traces.
ci-bot: Merge blocked: PR 7365 requires 1 more approval and a perf sign-off. (status: checks passing).
marta: tagging @shreya and @alex for approvals. If we can't get perf sign-off by EOD, revert plan is acceptable.
shreya: I'll review kernel changes in the PR now and leave comments. If I see a regression obvious from code, will request changes.
alex: If canary shows <=3% p99 delta we can proceed with a canary rollout and monitor. If >5% we revert. Sounds good?
marta: Sounds good. I'll attach the microbench script and raw logs here in a sec. Thanks for the quick responses — appreciate the canary help :pray:
bench-bot: extra_runs artifact: https://ci.internal/runs/7365/extra-runs-2026-03-17.tar.gz
shreya: Commented on PR with a couple of kernel-related nits; asking for a focused perf test for q4_0 path.
tj: Kickoff canary now with image sha-9f3b. Will report back in ~20-25m with p95/p99 from the pool.
marta: Updated PR description with links to bench artifacts and this thread. Leaving merge blocked until canary result/approval.
alex: Thanks team — ping me once tj posts canary numbers and I'll give the final thumbs for merge window. :thumbsup:
